blocks.text: a yoki the: tinglovchi nimani biladi?

Asosiy qoida qizil kitobdan tanish (→ qizil kitob, 69-dars): tinglovchi qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotganini **bilsa** — **the**, bilmasa yoki bu muhim bo'lmasa — **a / an**. U yerda o'zbekcha yordamchilarni ham ko'rgan edik: «bir» → **a**, «haligi, o'sha» va `-ni` → **the**. Bu darsda qoidaning «yashirin» tomonlari: **the** hech qachon tilga olinmagan narsa oldida ham keladi, **a** esa ba'zan aniq bir narsa oldida ham turadi. Har safar hal qiluvchi savol bitta: **tinglovchi qaysi biri ekanini aniqlay oladimi?**

rows: I bought a lamp and a rug. **The** rug was cheap.
We took a taxi. **The** driver was from Khiva.

blocks.text: Hikoya yoki xabarda yangi narsa **a / an** bilan «sahnaga chiqadi», keyin esa u tanish — **the**. Bu qoida B1–B2 matnlarda ham xuddi shunday ishlaydi, faqat masofa uzayadi: narsa uch-to'rt gap oldin tilga olingan bo'lsa ham, **the** saqlanadi. Lekin xuddi shu turdagi **boshqa** narsa paydo bo'lsa — yana **a**: I saw a fox, and then **another** fox / **a second** fox.

items.text: I saw **an** interesting **advert** for a job, but **the job** was in Nukus.
items.translation: **Qiziq bir e'lon** ko'rdim, lekin **ish** Nukusda ekan.

items.text: Two people came in: **a man** and **a teenager**. **The man** looked worried.
items.translation: Ikki kishi kirdi: **bir erkak** va **bir o'smir**. **Erkak** xavotirda ko'rinardi.

blocks.text: Aytilmagan, lekin bog'liq: a restaurant → the waiter

Bu B1 darajadagi eng muhim nozik holat. **a restaurant** deganimizda tinglovchining xayolida butun «restoran dunyosi» ochiladi: ofitsiant, menyu, hisob, oshxona. Shuning uchun ular birinchi marta tilga olinsa ham **the** bilan keladi: We went to **a** restaurant. **The** waiter was rude, and **the** bill was huge. O'zbekchada aynan shu joyda **egalik qo'shimchasi** paydo bo'ladi: «Restoranga bordik. **Ofitsianti** qo'pol, **hisobi** esa juda katta ekan.» Bu ajoyib kalit: `-i / -si` qo'shimchasi «oldingi narsaning qismi» degan ma'noni beradi — inglizchada bu **the**.

items.text: I bought **a** new **phone**, but **the screen** cracked on the first day.
items.translation: **Yangi telefon** oldim, lekin birinchi kuniyoq **ekrani** yorilib qoldi.

items.text: We went to **a concert** last night. **The music** was fantastic.
She read **a book** about Navoi and loved **the last chapter**.
items.translation: U Navoiy haqida **bir kitob** o'qidi, ayniqsa **oxirgi bobi** juda yoqdi.

blocks.text: Umumiy dunyo: the bank, the government

Shaharda ko'p bank bor, lekin «I'm going to **the** bank» deymiz: gap men doim boradigan bank yoki «bankka borish» ishi haqida. Xuddi shunday: **the** doctor (o'z shifokorim), **the** station (shahrimizning vokzali), **the** city centre. Mamlakat darajasida esa **the** government, **the** police, **the** economy, **the** president — gaplashayotganlarning umumiy dunyosida ular bitta. **a / an** esa «qaysidir biri», «har qanday»: Is there **a** bank near here? I need to see **a** doctor (qaysi biri bo'lsa ham).

headers: a / an — qaysidir biri, har qanday
rows: Is there **a** cash machine near here?
Meet me at **the** cash machine by the entrance.
I've got an appointment with **the** doctor tomorrow.
She works for **a** bank in London.
I must go to **the** bank before it closes.
**The** problem is that I've lost my passport.

blocks.text: To'rtinchi qatorga e'tibor bering: **The problem is (that) ...**, **The point is ...**, **The truth is ...**, **The trouble is ...** — turg'un boshlanmalar. O'zbekchadagi «Muammo shundaki ...», «Gap shundaki ...» ga to'g'ri keladi va doim **the** bilan.
Ma'nosi bo'yicha yagona: the first, the only, the right

Ba'zi so'zlar otni o'z-o'zidan yagona qiladi, shuning uchun ular bilan **the**: orttirma daraja (**the best**, **the most expensive**), tartib (**the first**, **the last**, **the next** — ketma-ketlikda), **the only**, **the same**, **the main**, **the right / the wrong** (vaziyatda to'g'ri javob bitta: **the wrong** bus — «boshqa avtobus»), **the opposite**. Qiziq istisno: **a second** «ikkinchi» emas, «yana bir» ma'nosida — **a second chance**, **a second opinion**.

items.text: Is this **the right platform** for the train to London?
items.translation: Londonga boradigan poyezd uchun **to'g'ri platforma** shumi?

items.text: She's **the only person** I trust completely.
Give him **a second chance** — everyone makes mistakes.
items.translation: Unga **yana bir imkoniyat** ber — hamma xato qiladi.

blocks.text: a man who ... yoki the man who ...?

Ko'p o'quvchilar «ot keyidan aniqlovchi kelsa — the» deb o'ylaydi. Bu yarim haqiqat. Aniqlovchi (who / that / which yoki in, of, with) otni **bitta qilib ajratsa** — **the**: **the** woman who lives upstairs (yuqorida bitta ayol yashaydi). Faqat **tasvirlasa**, lekin ko'pdan birini ko'rsatsa — **a**: I met **a** woman who works with your sister (opangizning hamkasblari ko'p). O'zbekchada farq «bir» bilan ko'rinadi: «opangiz bilan ishlaydigan **bir** ayol». **one of the** + ko'plik ham «ko'pdan biri»: Aziz is **one of the** students who won a scholarship.

items.text: **The man** who sold me this car lied about the mileage.
items.translation: Menga bu mashinani sotgan **odam** probeg haqida yolg'on gapirgan.

items.text: I know **a man** who can fix your car cheaply.
items.translation: Mashinangni arzonga tuzatib beradigan **bir odamni** bilaman.

items.text: Aziz is **one of the students** who won a scholarship.

blocks.text: a / an = har: twice a week, £10 an hour

Chastota, narx, tezlik va maoshda **a / an** «har», «-iga» ma'nosini beradi (→ qizil kitob, 65-dars): **twice a week** — haftasiga ikki marta, **£10 an hour** — soatiga 10 funt, **5,000 som a kilo** — kilosi 5 000 so'm. Rasmiy matn va narxnomalarda — **per**: £30 **per** person, 60 km **per** hour. Bu yerda **the** ham, «in» ham ishlatilmaydi: «two times in a week», «ten dollars for the hour» — xato.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: bog'liq narsani yangi deb o'ylash («I bought a phone, but a screen is broken» → **the screen**); «I'm going to a bank» (o'zim boradigan bank) → **I'm going to the bank**; «Government decided ...» → **The government** decided; «He is only person who ...» → **the only person**; «It's a best restaurant in town» → **the best restaurant**; «I met the man who works with your sister» (ko'pdan biri) → **a man**; «two times in a week» → **twice a week**; «ten dollars for one hour» → **ten dollars an hour**.

Egalik testi: o'zbekcha tarjimada otga egalik qo'shimchasini (`-i`, `-si`) yoki «o'sha», «haligi» so'zini qo'shib bo'lsa — ko'pincha **the**: «Taksiga o'tirdik, **haydovchisi** ...» → **the** driver; «**Muammo** shundaki ...» → **The** problem is ... «bir», «qandaydir», «...lardan biri» mos kelsa — **a / an**.

Bog'liq darslar: dunyoda yagona narsalar (the sun, the sea), the same, the cinema — 73-dars; umumiy va aniq ko'plik (children / the children) — 75-dars; joy nomlari — 77–78-darslar; orttirma daraja (the best) — 108-dars.

rows: **the** man who sold me the car (o'sha)

examples.title: First mention **a**, then **the**
examples.description: Yangi narsa birinchi marta a / an bilan kiritiladi, keyin u tanish — the. O'zbekchada «bir» → «o'sha» yoki `-ni`.

sentences.text: I ordered **a lamp** and **a rug** online, but only **the lamp** has arrived.
sentences.translation: Internetdan **chiroq** va **gilam** buyurtma qildim, lekin hozircha faqat **chiroq** keldi.

sentences.text: **A fire** broke out at a warehouse in Chilanzar last night, but firefighters put out **the fire** within an hour.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun Chilonzordagi omborxonada **yong'in** chiqdi, lekin o't o'chiruvchilar **uni** bir soat ichida o'chirishdi.

sentences.text: We looked at **a flat** in the centre and **a house** in the suburbs. **The house** was cheaper.
sentences.translation: Markazdagi **bir kvartira** va shahar chetidagi **bir uyni** ko'rdik. **Uy** arzonroq ekan.

sentences.text: Dilnoza received **a letter** from Edinburgh, and **the letter** said she had won a scholarship.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Edinburgdan **xat** oldi, **xatda** u grant yutgani aytilgan edi.

sentences.text: Once there was **a king** who had three daughters, and **the youngest** was the cleverest.
sentences.translation: Qadim zamonda uch qizi bor **bir podshoh** yashagan ekan, **kenjasi** eng aqllisi ekan.

sentences.text: I had **an interview** on Monday. **The interview** went well, but **the questions** were hard.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni **suhbatim** bor edi. **Suhbat** yaxshi o'tdi, lekin **savollar** qiyin edi.

sentences.text: Tom adopted **a cat** from the shelter, and now **the cat** sleeps on his bed every night.
sentences.translation: Tom boshpanadan **mushuk** olib keldi, endi **o'sha mushuk** har kecha uning karavotida uxlaydi.

sentences.text: There's **a new café** opposite the station. Have you tried **the coffee** there?
sentences.translation: Vokzal qarshisida **yangi kafe** ochildi. U yerning **qahvasini** tatib ko'rdingmi?

sentences.text: The police are looking for **a car** that was stolen yesterday; **the car** is a red Malibu.
sentences.translation: Politsiya kecha o'g'irlangan **mashinani** qidiryapti; **mashina** — qizil rangli Malibu.

sentences.text: My grandmother gave me **a ring** and **a necklace**, and I wore **the ring** at my wedding.
sentences.translation: Buvim menga **uzuk** va **marjon** sovg'a qilgan edi, **o'sha uzukni** to'yimda taqdim.

examples.title: Linked things: **a** restaurant → **the** waiter
examples.description: Narsa oldin aytilmagan bo'lsa ham, avval tilga olingan narsaning qismi yoki bir bo'lagi bo'lsa — the. O'zbekchada ko'pincha egalik qo'shimchasi: «taksiga o'tirdik, haydovchisi ...».

sentences.text: We had dinner at **a Georgian restaurant**, but **the waiter** was very rude.
sentences.translation: **Gruzin restoranida** kechki ovqat qildik, lekin **ofitsianti** juda qo'pol ekan.

sentences.text: I bought **a second-hand laptop**, and **the battery** lasts only an hour.
sentences.translation: **Ishlatilgan noutbuk** oldim, **batareyasi** bor-yo'g'i bir soat chidaydi.

sentences.text: We took **a taxi** to the airport, and **the driver** turned out to be from Khiva.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga **taksida** bordik, **haydovchisi** xivalik bo'lib chiqdi.

sentences.text: Aziz read **a novel** about the Silk Road, but he didn't like **the ending**.
sentences.translation: Aziz Ipak yo'li haqida **bir roman** o'qidi, lekin uning **oxiri** yoqmadi.

sentences.text: Madina has just moved into **a new flat**, but **the kitchen** is tiny.
sentences.translation: Madina **yangi kvartiraga** endi ko'chib o'tdi, lekin **oshxonasi** juda kichkina.

sentences.text: We stayed in **a small hotel** near the Registan, and **the staff** were wonderful.
sentences.translation: Registon yaqinidagi **kichik mehmonxonada** turdik, **xodimlari** ajoyib edi.

sentences.text: I went to **a wedding** last weekend, and **the bride** turned out to be my old classmate.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kuni **to'yga** bordim, **kelin** mening eski sinfdoshim bo'lib chiqdi.

sentences.text: James watched **a football match** in Manchester, but **the tickets** cost a fortune.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Manchesterda **futbol o'yini** tomosha qildi, lekin **chiptalari** juda qimmatga tushdi.

sentences.text: When you buy **a used car**, always check **the brakes** and **the tyres**.
sentences.translation: **Ishlatilgan mashina** sotib olayotganda doim **tormozi** va **shinalarini** tekshiring.

sentences.text: Jasur applied for **a job** at a bank, but **the salary** was lower than he expected, so he refused **the offer**.
sentences.translation: Jasur bankdagi **bir ishga** ariza topshirdi, lekin **maoshi** kutganidan past ekan, shuning uchun **taklifni** rad etdi.

examples.title: Shared world: **the** bank, **the** government
examples.description: Shaharda yoki mamlakatda hamma biladigan joy va tashkilotlar — the: the government, the police, the station, the city centre; o'zim boradigan bank va shifokor — the bank, the doctor.

sentences.text: **The government** has promised to build more schools in rural areas.
sentences.translation: **Hukumat** qishloq hududlarida ko'proq maktab qurishga va'da berdi.

sentences.text: Someone broke into our car, so we called **the police** immediately.
sentences.translation: Kimdir mashinamizni buzib ochdi, shuning uchun darhol **politsiyaga** qo'ng'iroq qildik.

sentences.text: I need to go to **the bank** before it closes at five.
sentences.translation: Soat beshda yopilmasidan oldin **bankka** borishim kerak.

sentences.text: How do I get to **the city centre** from **the airport**?
sentences.translation: **Aeroportdan** **shahar markaziga** qanday borsam bo'ladi?

sentences.text: You should see **the doctor** about that cough — it's been two weeks.
sentences.translation: O'sha yo'tal bilan **shifokorga** ko'rinishingiz kerak — ikki hafta bo'ldi-ku.

sentences.text: Everyone is talking about **the economy** because prices keep rising.
sentences.translation: Narxlar oshib borayotgani uchun hamma **iqtisodiyot** haqida gapiryapti.

sentences.text: Let's meet at **the station** at half past eight and take the first train.
sentences.translation: Soat sakkiz yarimda **vokzalda** uchrashib, birinchi poyezdga chiqaylik.

sentences.text: My father has worked at **the post office** in our town for thirty years.
sentences.translation: Otam o'ttiz yildan beri shahrimizdagi **pochtada** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: **The president** will visit Fergana next week to open a new hospital.
sentences.translation: **Prezident** kelasi hafta yangi shifoxonani ochish uchun Farg'onaga tashrif buyuradi.

sentences.text: If the lights go out again, call **the electricity company** — **the number** is on the fridge.
sentences.translation: Agar chiroq yana o'chsa, **elektr kompaniyasiga** qo'ng'iroq qil — **raqami** muzlatgichda yozilgan.

examples.title: **a** = any one, **the** = the one we know
examples.description: a — qaysidir biri, har qanday; the — aynan o'sha, gaplashayotganlar biladigani. Ko'p gaplarda ikkalasi yonma-yon.

sentences.text: Is there **a cash machine** near here? — Yes, there's one next to **the bakery**.
sentences.translation: Shu atrofda **bankomat** bormi? — Ha, **novvoyxona** yonida bittasi bor.

sentences.text: Can you recommend **a good hotel** in Oxford? — Try **the one** where we stayed last year.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda **yaxshi mehmonxona** tavsiya qila olasizmi? — O'tgan yili biz turgan **o'sha mehmonxonani** sinab ko'ring.

sentences.text: I'd like to rent **a car** for the weekend, preferably an automatic.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari uchun **mashina** ijaraga olmoqchiman, iloji bo'lsa avtomat qutili.

sentences.text: Where did you park **the car**? I can't see it anywhere.
sentences.translation: **Mashinani** qayerga qo'yding? Hech qayerda ko'rmayapman.

sentences.text: Could you pass me **a pen**? Any colour will do.
sentences.translation: **Ruchka** berib yuborasanmi? Qanday rang bo'lsa ham mayli.

sentences.text: Have you seen **the pen** that was on my desk? It was a present.
sentences.translation: Stolimda turgan **ruchkani** ko'rdingmi? U sovg'a edi.

sentences.text: There's **a problem** with the printer again. — What's **the problem** this time?
sentences.translation: Printerda yana **muammo** bor. — Bu safar **muammo** nima ekan?

sentences.text: **The problem** is that nobody remembers the password.
sentences.translation: **Muammo** shundaki, hech kim parolni eslay olmaydi.

sentences.text: Bekzod is looking for **a flat** to rent, but **the flats** in the centre are too expensive.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ijaraga **kvartira** qidiryapti, lekin markazdagi **kvartiralar** juda qimmat.

sentences.text: We need **a new manager** because **the manager** we have now is leaving for Dubai in April.
sentences.translation: Bizga **yangi rahbar** kerak, chunki hozirgi **rahbarimiz** aprelda Dubayga ketyapti.

examples.title: **the first**, **the only**, **the right**, **the same**
examples.description: Ma'nosiga ko'ra bitta bo'ladigan narsa — the: the first / last / next, the only, the best, the right / wrong, the same, the main. Lekin a second chance — «yana bir imkoniyat».

sentences.text: Nilufar was **the first person** in her family to go to university.
sentences.translation: Nilufar oilasida universitetga kirgan **birinchi odam** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I think you're on **the wrong bus** — this one goes to the airport.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, menimcha, **boshqa avtobusga** chiqib qolibsiz — bu aeroportga boradi.

sentences.text: Is this **the right way** to the museum? — Yes, keep going straight.
sentences.translation: Muzeyga **to'g'ri ketyapmanmi**? — Ha, to'g'riga yuravering.

sentences.text: Oliver was **the only student** who passed the exam with full marks.
sentences.translation: Imtihonni to'liq ball bilan topshirgan **yagona talaba** Oliver bo'ldi.

sentences.text: This is **the best plov** I've eaten in Tashkent, and I've tried a lot.
sentences.translation: Bu Toshkentda yegan **eng mazali palovim**, vaholanki, ko'p joyda yeb ko'rganman.

sentences.text: We were born on **the same day** in **the same hospital**!
sentences.translation: Biz **bir kunda**, **bitta tug'ruqxonada** tug'ilganmiz!

sentences.text: **The main reason** I left the company was the long hours.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyadan ketishimning **asosiy sababi** — uzoq ish soatlari edi.

sentences.text: We missed the 8.15, so we'll have to take **the next train**.
sentences.translation: 8:15 dagi poyezdga ulgurmadik, endi **keyingi poyezdga** chiqishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Everyone deserves **a second chance**, so I've decided to forgive him.
sentences.translation: Har kim **yana bir imkoniyatga** loyiq, shuning uchun uni kechirishga qaror qildim.

sentences.text: That was **the last time** I lent Jasur money, because he still hasn't paid me back.
sentences.translation: Jasurga **oxirgi marta** o'shanda qarz berganman, chunki u hali ham qaytarmadi.

examples.title: **a** woman who ... / **the** woman who ...
examples.description: Aniqlovchi ergash gap yoki predlogli birikma o'z-o'zidan the talab qilmaydi. Bitta narsani ajratib ko'rsatsa — the, ko'pdan birini tasvirlasa — a / an.

sentences.text: **The woman** who lives upstairs plays the piano every evening.
sentences.translation: Yuqori qavatda yashaydigan **ayol** har oqshom pianino chaladi.

sentences.text: I met **a woman** who works with your sister at the hospital.
sentences.translation: Opang bilan kasalxonada birga ishlaydigan **bir ayol** bilan tanishdim.

sentences.text: **The book** you lent me was so good that I finished it in two days.
sentences.translation: Menga bergan **kitobing** shunchalik yaxshi ekanki, ikki kunda tugatdim.

sentences.text: Sarah is reading **a book** that her teacher recommended.
sentences.translation: Sara o'qituvchisi tavsiya qilgan **bir kitobni** o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: Who's that? — He's **a friend** of my brother's from university.
sentences.translation: Bu kim? — Akamning universitetdagi **do'stlaridan biri**.

sentences.text: **The man** in the grey suit is our new director.
sentences.translation: Kulrang kostyumdagi **kishi** — yangi direktorimiz.

sentences.text: There's **a man** downstairs who says he's from the gas company.
sentences.translation: Pastda o'zini gaz kompaniyasidan deyayotgan **bir kishi** turibdi.

sentences.text: Madina is **one of the doctors** who work in the children's ward.
sentences.translation: Madina bolalar bo'limida ishlaydigan **shifokorlardan biri**.

sentences.text: Thanks for **the photos** you sent from Khiva — they're amazing!
sentences.translation: Xivadan yuborgan **suratlaring** uchun rahmat — ajoyib!

sentences.text: Kate works for **a company** that makes solar panels, not for **the company** that built our office.
sentences.translation: Keyt ofisimizni qurgan **kompaniyada** emas, quyosh panellari ishlab chiqaradigan **bir kompaniyada** ishlaydi.

examples.title: **a** = per: twice **a** week, £12 **an** hour
examples.description: a / an «har», «-iga» ma'nosida: chastota, narx, tezlik, maosh. Rasmiy uslubda — per. Bu yerda the ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: I go to the gym **three times a week**, usually after work.
sentences.translation: Sport zaliga **haftasiga uch marta**, odatda ishdan keyin boraman.

sentences.text: Students who work in London cafés earn about **twelve pounds an hour**.
sentences.translation: Londondagi kafelarda ishlaydigan talabalar **soatiga** taxminan **o'n ikki funt** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Tomatoes cost **fifteen thousand som a kilo** at the market today.
sentences.translation: Bugun bozorda pomidorning **kilosi o'n besh ming so'm**.

sentences.text: The speed limit here is **forty miles an hour**, but nobody seems to care.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda tezlik chegarasi **soatiga qirq mil**, lekin hech kim e'tibor bermayotganga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: Take one tablet **twice a day** after meals.
sentences.translation: Ovqatdan keyin **kuniga ikki marta** bittadan tabletka iching.

sentences.text: The tour costs **eighty dollars per person**, including lunch.
sentences.translation: Ekskursiya **har bir kishi uchun** sakson dollar, tushlik bilan birga.

sentences.text: How often do you visit your parents? — **Once a month**, if I'm lucky.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangnikiga qanchalik tez-tez borasan? — Omadim kelsa, **oyiga bir marta**.

sentences.text: Bekzod earns about two thousand dollars **a month** as a software developer.
sentences.translation: Bekzod dasturchi sifatida **oyiga** taxminan ikki ming dollar ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Our internet costs **a hundred thousand som a month**, which is quite cheap.
sentences.translation: Internetimiz **oyiga yuz ming so'm**, bu ancha arzon.

sentences.text: In some parts of the world, families live on **less than two dollars a day**, so even school books are a luxury.
sentences.translation: Dunyoning ayrim joylarida oilalar **kuniga ikki dollardan kam** pulga kun ko'radi, shuning uchun hatto maktab kitoblari ham hashamat hisoblanadi.

examples.title: Mixed: **a** or **the**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: birinchi va qayta tilga olish, bog'liq narsa, umumiy dunyo, yagona narsa — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Last week I went to **a conference** in Manchester, and **the speakers** were excellent.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta Manchesterdagi **konferensiyaga** bordim, **ma'ruzachilari** a'lo darajada edi.

sentences.text: Can you turn off **the air conditioner**? It's freezing in here.
sentences.translation: **Konditsionerni** o'chirib qo'ya olasizmi? Bu yer muzlab ketdi.

sentences.text: Jasur bought **a house** outside Samarkand, but **the roof** needs repairing.
sentences.translation: Jasur Samarqand tashqarisidan **uy** sotib oldi, lekin **tomini** ta'mirlash kerak.

sentences.text: **The Minister of Health** said that **a new hospital** would open in Nukus.
sentences.translation: **Sog'liqni saqlash vaziri** Nukusda **yangi shifoxona** ochilishini aytdi.

sentences.text: Is this **the bus** to the airport, or do I need **a different one**?
sentences.translation: Bu aeroportga boradigan **avtobusmi** yoki menga **boshqasi** kerakmi?

sentences.text: Emma had **an idea** for a business, and **the idea** made her a millionaire.
sentences.translation: Emmaning **bir biznes g'oyasi** bor edi va **o'sha g'oya** uni millioner qildi.

sentences.text: We waited an hour at **the reception desk** before **a nurse** finally called my name.
sentences.translation: **Qabulxonada** bir soat kutdik, keyin nihoyat **bir hamshira** ismimni chaqirdi.

sentences.text: There was **a strange smell** in the flat, so we opened all **the windows**.
sentences.translation: Kvartirada **g'alati hid** bor edi, shuning uchun hamma **derazalarni** ochdik.

sentences.text: What's **the name** of **the hotel** you stayed at in Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: Edinburgda turgan **mehmonxonangizning nomi** nima edi?

sentences.text: **A report** published today says that **the number** of tourists visiting Uzbekistan has doubled.
sentences.translation: Bugun e'lon qilingan **bir hisobotga** ko'ra, O'zbekistonga keladigan sayyohlar **soni** ikki baravar oshgan.
